dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures feature sharp, high-contrast outer perimeters with irregular, serrated edge geometry, exhibiting a rapid gradient transition from dark exterior to light interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is visible on the anterior dorsal surface; several larger, isolated high-intensity blobs are clustered near the posterior terminus.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-body region form an irregular quadrilateral, while a series of smaller posterior blobs form a distinct curvilinear chain.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, reticulated web-like topology is formed by the merging of multiple high-contrast rings across the dorsal-lateral region.
